text: 中共中央政治局常委、全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际9月21日至24日在吉林、黑龙江调研。他强调，要更加自觉地、具体地践行全过程人民民主，把人民代表大会制度坚持好完善好运行好，高质量做好地方人大工作，为贯彻落实“十五五”规划、推动和保障地方改革发展稳定作出应有贡献。（新华社）
text_en: Zhao Leji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, conducted research in Jilin and Heilongjiang from September 21 to 24. He stressed the need to more consciously and concretely practice whole-process people's democracy, uphold, improve and operate the people's congress system well, and carry out local people's congress work with high quality, so as to make due contributions to implementing the 15th Five-Year Plan and promoting and safeguarding local reform, development and stability. (Xinhua News Agency)
